footer.description.message: Made by and for the community. JSConf Brasil is a non-profit event dedicated to driving web development and strengthening the JavaScript community in Brazil.

team.subtitle.message: International experts and local talent sharing the future of the web.

team.erick.bio.message: Erick Wendel is an experienced tech conference speaker, known as a keynote speaker, and a renowned developer on the Node.js core team.

team.ana.bio.message: Ana Neri is a Senior Software Engineer, NodeBR Leader.... passionate about community

team.lojhan.bio.message: Tech Lead & Full Stack Developer. Helping teams build scalable applications with modern technologies. Specialized in frontend, backend and architecture design.

team.cristian.bio.message: Graduated in Systems Analysis and Development from Fatec Rubens Lara, passionate about technology and problem solving. I love learning new things every day and teaching those around me.

team.lucas.bio.message: With over 15 years of experience, he has worked at companies such as Microsoft and Klarna. He is part of the Node.js contributors team, a book author and an international speaker.

team.micaele.bio.message: Micaele Magalhães is an illustrator and designer, ADS student, responsible for the visual identity of several Brazilian open source projects, such as the mascot of the Poku test runner and Awesome You (an initiative that highlights open source project maintainers in Brazil).

team.monica.bio.message: Born and raised in Rio, former artistic roller skater, gamer, #TechMaromba, Emotional Dev, used to do calculations but nowadays I'm "just on the compiuter", energy drink lover and aspiring Tech Influencer.
